name: fortrip

tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description: Find hotels by destination and/or text, with an indicative per-room-night price when a stay is given. destination is a place_name with its countryCode, a place or locality by placeId from an earlier answer, a point, or a country. A name several places bear answers destination_ambiguous with candidates: ask the user, then search the chosen placeId. text matches hotel names, brands and areas word for word. Indicative prices are estimates and not bookable: get_hotel_offers returns what the user pays. A search too broad to answer is refused with search_too_broad and its localities: pass one back as { kind: "locality", placeId }, never by name. The answer states the scope, the counts and notes; a next page is the cursor and, optionally, limit.

destination.description: Where to search. A first page needs this or `text`.

kind.description: A place named in words, with its country.

name.description: The place name, in any language, e.g. Tokyo or 东京.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country the place is in, e.g. JP.

radiusMeters.description: Search radius around the destination in meters, 1 to 80000. Left out, the service picks one.

kind.description: A place id from an earlier response.

radiusMeters.description: Search radius around the destination in meters, 1 to 80000. Left out, the service picks one.
Search radius around the destination in meters, 1 to 80000. Left out, the service picks one.

kind.description: A locality listed in an earlier search response.

radiusMeters.description: Search radius around the destination in meters, 1 to 80000. Left out, the service picks one.

text.description: Hotel name, brand or area to match, 1 to 128 characters. A first page needs this or `destination`.

stay.description: Dates and party. Needed for indicative prices. Search uses only the dates when the rooms differ.

checkIn.description: Check-in date in the hotel's calendar, yyyy-MM-dd.

checkOut.description: Check-out date in the hotel's calendar, yyyy-MM-dd. Stays are 1 to 15 nights; a longer one answers stay_unsupported (max_nights), and past 30 nights invalid_request: ask the user whether to split it into consecutive stays.

childrenAges.description: Age of each child in this room, 0 to 17. An empty list means no children.

rooms.description: The rooms wanted, 1 to 8, each with its party; offers and orders need every room the same.

pricing.description: `indicative` adds an approximate price per hotel and needs a stay; `none` skips prices. Default: indicative with a stay, otherwise none.

filters.description: Filters every hotel in the answer must pass.

stars.description: Star rating range. Unrated hotels are left out whenever it is set.

min.description: Lowest star rating, 1 to 5 in steps of 0.5.

max.description: Highest star rating, 1 to 5 in steps of 0.5.

amenities.description: Amenities every hotel must list. Only some codes can filter; asking for one that cannot is answered with the list that can.

price.description: Price limit. Needs indicative pricing, so a stay.

amount.description: Decimal string such as 132.40, never a number.

maxPerRoomNight.description: Highest price per room per night, in the search's currency.

sort.description: Result order. `distance` needs a destination, `relevance` needs `text`, `price_asc` and `price_desc` need indicative pricing. Default: relevance with `text`, otherwise distance.

cursor.description: `nextCursor` from the previous response. A next page is the cursor and, optionally, `limit`; nothing else.

locale.description: Language for names and text in the response: en or zh.

currency.description: The currency to price and charge in: USD (default) or CNY, where available (otherwise the answer is currency_unavailable). Use CNY only for a user who pays with Alipay, WeChat Pay or a bank card from mainland China, the only ways a CNY order can be paid: when they ask for CNY or say they pay that way. Ask only when the conversation suggests it; otherwise keep USD.

tools.name: get_hotel
tools.description: One hotel's catalogue facts: names, address, location, time zone, check-in and check-out times, the full description, every policy and the amenities, and its rooms with include: "rooms". "Not listed" is not "no". No prices or availability: get_hotel_offers has those.

locale.description: Language for names and text in the response: en or zh.

tools.name: get_hotel_offers
tools.description: Live, bookable offers for up to 15 hotels and one stay. Every room in stay.rooms must have the same party: for different parties, call once per party. Each offer has the room, the meals included, price.total, in the request's currency, for the whole stay and every room (what is charged), fees payable at the property, the cancellation terms with times in UTC and the hotel's time zone, the confirmation mode, and an offerId for book_hotel that expires at expiresAt. Hotels with nothing to offer are listed under unavailable with the reason. Up to limitPerHotel offers per hotel, default 15, chosen for a spread of choices in this order while room remains: the cheapest offer, the cheapest that can be cancelled free, the cheapest with breakfast, the cheapest of each other room, then the rest by price; listed cheapest first.

hotelIds.description: Hotels to price, 1 to 15, no repeats.

checkIn.description: Check-in date in the hotel's calendar, yyyy-MM-dd.

checkOut.description: Check-out date in the hotel's calendar, yyyy-MM-dd. Stays are 1 to 15 nights; a longer one answers stay_unsupported (max_nights), and past 30 nights invalid_request: ask the user whether to split it into consecutive stays.

childrenAges.description: Age of each child in this room, 0 to 17. An empty list means no children.

rooms.description: The rooms wanted, 1 to 8, each with its party; offers and orders need every room the same.

stay.description: Dates and party. One party per call: every room must be the same.

requireBreakfast.description: Keep only offers that include breakfast.

requireFreeCancellation.description: Keep only offers that can still be cancelled free of charge.

locale.description: Language for names and text in the response: en or zh.

currency.description: The currency to price and charge in: USD (default) or CNY, where available (otherwise the answer is currency_unavailable). Use CNY only for a user who pays with Alipay, WeChat Pay or a bank card from mainland China, the only ways a CNY order can be paid: when they ask for CNY or say they pay that way. Ask only when the conversation suggests it; otherwise keep USD. An order made from these offers is charged in this currency.

tools.name: book_hotel
tools.description: Order one offer from get_hotel_offers. The answer is an unpaid order with a payment link: status awaiting_payment, the total, the stay and its terms, and payment.url, a Fortrip page to pay on. Nothing is charged until the order is paid, on that page or with pay_order (or Alipay/WeChat Pay); anyone holding the link can pay. Send the contact and, for each room of the offer, at least one guest. If the price or terms changed since the offer, the answer is offer_changed with every change and a new offer: show the changes and ask the user again before ordering it. Sending the same details again returns the same order. An offer is ordered once: for another order of the stay (another party, or a corrected guest name), get offers again and order the new offer; when it replaces an unpaid order, tell the user to pay only the new link, as the earlier one expires unpaid. To cancel an order, use cancel_order; for changes, or a cancellation cancel_order can't make, the user emails info@fortrip.ai with the order's reference.

firstName.description: Contact person's first name, at most 59 characters.

lastName.description: Contact person's last name, at most 59 characters.

email.description: Contact email; the confirmation is sent here.

phone.description: Contact phone number, with country code.

contact.description: Who the hotel and the confirmation reach.

firstName.description: Guest's first name, in Latin letters as on the passport; transliterate accents (Müller → Mueller).

lastName.description: Guest's last name, in Latin letters as on the passport.

guests.description: Guests staying in this room: at least one, no more than the room sleeps.

rooms.description: One entry per room of the offer, in order.

specialRequests.description: Requests for the hotel, in English. Not guaranteed.

hotel.description: What the hotel needs to know.

items.description: The offer to book: exactly one.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: One of the user's orders by orderId: its status, the payment status and, while it awaits payment, payment.url; the stay and its terms; and the hotel's confirmation number once there is one. Check it after the user pays. An order awaiting payment whose payment.url is null had its link unreadable this time: read it again.

locale.description: Language for names and text in the response: en or zh.

tools.name: list_orders
tools.description: The user's hotel orders, newest first, including those made on the Fortrip website. Pass nextCursor back as cursor for the next page.

cursor.description: `nextCursor` from the previous page of orders.

locale.description: Language for names and text in the response: en or zh.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel a paid order under its terms, or close an unpaid one. Paid (cancel.reason cancellable): the hotel booking is cancelled and cancel.refund is refunded. Before you call cancel_order, show the user the order's stay (hotel, dates), cancel.penalty and cancel.refund (amount and currency), then end your reply by asking them to confirm the cancellation, and wait for a clear yes. Pass maximumPenalty as cancel.penalty, exactly as returned. Never state a refund the order did not return. Penalty now above maximumPenalty: cancellation_changed, nothing changed; ask again. Then poll get_order: cancelling, then cancelled. Hotel refused: confirmed, reason refused. Unpaid (cancel.reason unpaid): close it only once the user says they no longer want it, without maximumPenalty; nothing is charged; it becomes expired. Paid meanwhile: the answer is the paid order or invalid_request; then cancel only under cancel.penalty, with the user's yes. payment_in_progress: read it again shortly. Repeat calls answer the order as it is.

orderId.description: The orderId of the order to cancel.

maximumPenalty.description: The penalty the user agreed to: the order's cancel.penalty, exactly as returned. Ignored when closing an unpaid order.

amount.description: Decimal string such as 132.40, never a number.

tools.name: pay_order
tools.description: Pay an order without its link, by one of its payment.methods: a shared payment token, or Alipay/WeChat Pay (method stripe_alipay_wechat_pay). Token: only if you can request one from the user's Link wallet (US and Canadian accounts); never ask the user for one. First show the user the total and currency, the stay and every term (meals, cancellation, fees payable at the property), ask them to confirm and wait for a clear yes. Token: request it with the entry's handler config.business_profile and limits; pass it with price.total. Wallet: pass method, price.total; show the wallet entry (WeChat code as an image if you can, both links); they pay once by either; a code lasts 120 minutes; then the WeChat link opens a new one, or call again. Pay one way only: payment.url or pay_order. Success closes payment.url; failure leaves it open. Then poll get_order. payment_total_changed: confirm details.total, retry. payment_credential_invalid: new token. service_unavailable: retry. Else payment.url. A token pays one order.

orderId.description: The orderId of the order to pay.

sharedPaymentToken.description: The shared payment token (spt_…) the user approved for this order, requested with the limits of the order's stripe_shared_payment_token method. Exactly one of sharedPaymentToken, payment and method.

payment.description: UCP's Complete Checkout payment, in place of sharedPaymentToken: the token as the stripe_payment_token credential of the one selected stripe_payments card instrument. Exactly one of sharedPaymentToken, payment and method.

id.description: The instrument's id, as the agent's UCP client names it.

handler_id.description: The id of the handler the instrument pays through: the order's stripe_payments for the selected one.

type.description: The instrument type: card for the selected one. A Link token is presented as a card instrument, whatever Link funds it with.

selected.description: Whether this is the instrument to pay with. Exactly one is selected; a lone instrument without it is the one.

credential.description: The instrument's credential: for the selected one, the shared payment token.

type.description: The credential type: stripe_payment_token for the selected one.

token.description: The shared payment token (spt_…) the user approved for this order, requested with the limits of the order's stripe_shared_payment_token method.

display.description: How the wallet shows the instrument, as UCP has it. Not used to pay.

instruments.description: The instruments, exactly one of them selected.

method.description: Pay by a method in payment.methods other than the token, which is paid with sharedPaymentToken or payment. Exactly one of sharedPaymentToken, payment and method.

amount.description: Decimal string such as 132.40, never a number.

total.description: The total the user approved: the order's price.total, in its currency, exactly as returned.

instructions:
Fortrip: hotel search, live offers and orders with a payment link.

Call order: `search_hotels` → (optional) `get_hotel` → `get_hotel_offers` → `book_hotel`; after the user pays, `get_order`; `list_orders` lists, `cancel_order` cancels or closes an unpaid one, `pay_order` pays by token or Alipay/WeChat Pay.

Sign-in happens only in the browser. Never ask the user to paste a token.
If a tool says the user isn't signed in, ask them to reconnect.

- A place name needs its `countryCode` (ask the user if unclear) and matches exactly (accents and periods count). On `destination_ambiguous`, ask the user which they mean, then search its `placeId`; never pick one yourself.
- On `search_too_broad`, show its `localities` and ask the user which, unless they already named one; search it as `{ kind: "locality", placeId }`, never by name.
- `text` matches whole words of hotel names and addresses: use a distinctive name, brand or landmark.

- Offers and orders take one party per call, every room the same: for different parties, order once per party.

- Search prices are indicative, not bookable: quote `get_hotel_offers` prices.
- `price.total` is the whole stay for all rooms and is what is charged, in the request's `currency` (`USD` by default); an order is in the currency of the offer it was made from. On a USD order, Stripe's page may let the user pay in their card's local currency at Stripe's rate.

- "Not listed" or "unknown" is not "no".

- Call `book_hotel` only for the offer the user picked, with at least one guest per room; never invent guests.
- Guest names: Latin letters as on the passport (Müller → Mueller), first and last name 1–60 characters each.
- `book_hotel` can take about two minutes. If it times out, call it again with the same details: it returns the same order.
- On `offer_changed`, show the user every change and ask again before ordering the new offer.

- Pay one way only: give `payment.url` or call `pay_order`. First show the order's total and currency, the stay and every term, end that reply by asking the user to confirm, and wait for a clear yes. Then give `payment.url` exactly as returned, to this user only: anyone holding it can pay.
- Never ask for, accept or pass on payment card details; payment happens only on `payment.url` or by a way in the order's `payment.methods`.

For changes, a cancellation that `cancel_order` can't make, or other problems, the user emails info@fortrip.ai with the order's `reference` (never `payment.url`).
